source_text: Welfare Footprint Institute「Cage-free aviaries prevent an average of at least 275 hours of disabling pain, 2,313 hours of hurtful pain and 4,645 hours of annoying pain for each hen during her laying life compared to conventional cages, and 1,410 hours of hurtful pain and 4,065 hours of annoying pain compared to furnished cages.」
